title: Projektetage Enlarge Tile Cover
description: When enlarging a split/catalogue tile it shows the full original image instead of only the tile crop. Enlarged view must cover with the same tile crop as the thumbnail.
summary: Fixed enlarged split/catalogue tiles showing the full source image instead of the cropped tile. Root cause: interactive enlarge cleared `disposition.position`, so `MorphDispositionView` / `FigureMorphView` fell back to a plain `` of the whole figure. Fix: when enlarged, cropped figure dispositions keep crop rendering with `SLIDE_INTERACTIVE_ENLARGE_FRAME` as the cover frame; PDF/video enlarge still strips position to avoid nested frames. 96 renderer tests pass.
